newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's employers, unions start a key meeting.
newsitem.headline: Spain's employers, unions start a key meeting.

text.p: Spain's employers and trade unions started talks on Tuesday to see if they could reach a deal on labour reform without government intervention.
Leaders of the workers' commission (CCOO), the general workers unions (UGT) and the employers association (CEOE) will announce the results of their meeting at a news conference after the talks.

On Tuesday, Spanish employers' association (CEOE) president Jose Maria Cuevas said he saw no way to agree on a reform of some dismissal rules and that it would require a maximum effort to reach an overall deal.
On Monday, unions blamed employers for being too inflexible and endangering a deal.
The government had given unions and employers until early March to reach a deal and warned last week that it was ready to step in and impose a package of measures.
